etymology: 古い英語 bān(骨) → 骨 → (骨組み→)いちばん奥・芯(to the bone=骨の髄まで)

en_definitions.text: one of the hard parts that form the frame of a human or animal body.

cautions: have a bone to pick with A=Aに言いたい文句がある
to the bone=骨の髄まで・徹底的に

patterns.form: have a bone to pick with A

examples.label: 骨折
examples.en: He broke a bone in his foot.

examples.label: 文句
examples.en: I have a bone to pick with you.
examples.ja: 君にちょっと言いたいことがある。

examples.label: 骨の髄
examples.en: We were chilled to the bone.
examples.ja: 私たちは骨の髄まで冷えきった。

examples.label: 率直
examples.en: She made no bones about her dislike of him.
examples.ja: 彼女は彼が嫌いなことを隠さなかった。

examples.label: 骨
examples.en: Milk is good for your bones.

examples.label: 犬
examples.en: The dog buried a bone in the yard.

check_points: have a bone to pick with A の意味を言えるか
